content.text: Section 11 squarely addresses this rule. No redline needed.

input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form.
input.rationale: Section 11 meets the preferred position in full: transition obligations trigger on expiry or termination for any reason (11.1), assistance runs up to six months (11.1), Customer Data is returned within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format (11.2), and an authorized officer certifies deletion in writing after return (11.3). Two variances are in our favour and are noted rather than flagged: assistance is priced at the rates in the expiring Order Form rather than Vendor's then-current rates, and the thirty-day return clock runs from Customer's request, giving us control of timing. Section 11.2 also confirms Vendor may not withhold Customer Data over a fee dispute, so return is not conditioned on payment. Nothing in Sections 10 or 15 cuts this back.
